Original_task_description: Receive / identify purchasing need through Exact or external request
Rule: VW1 if requirements are developed; VW4 for an already defined request.

Original_task_description: Create purchasing entry / PO lines in Exact for an external request
Short_label: Create order lines for an external request
Rule: Create the order from the received request.

Original_task_description: Transfer information from screenshot / email / colleague request into Exact
Rule: Data entry for order preparation; retain any separate clarification episode.

Original_task_description: Validate supplied article / machine / service information
Rule: VW1 if defining requirements; VW4 if validating an existing order request.

Original_task_description: Search historical POs to resolve suspicious information when validation raises doubt
Short_label: Investigate doubtful information in old POs
Rule: History is an information source; the purpose decides the stage.

Original_task_description: Assess stock, future demand, open POs, receipts, lead time and urgency
Short_label: Assess stock demand lead time and urgency
Rule: Supports order quantity and timing; reading receipt data does not make this logistics work.

Original_task_description: Check additional same-supplier demand for maximalisatie as part of normal order processing
Short_label: Search same supplier demand for MAX
Rule: Consolidation within order preparation.

Original_task_description: Determine whether useful same-supplier demand is currently available for consolidation
Short_label: Decide whether useful demand can be added
Rule: Embedded decisions remain attributes of the timed episode.

Original_task_description: If useful demand is available, combine the relevant same-supplier demand; the resulting order still proceeds to the post-MAX hold/proceed assessment
Rule: Retain combined PO and MAX time when inseparable.

Original_task_description: After MAX, whether or not demand was added, assess whether the resulting order is small/non-urgent or otherwise ready to proceed
Rule: Assess the resulting order whether demand was added or not.

Original_task_description: If the resulting post-MAX order is small and non-urgent, hold/pause it; otherwise proceed with ordering
Rule: HOLD is an outcome; the waiting interval is not active buyer time.

Original_task_description: Review Exact `Advies` and underlying demand
Rule: Review demand for order preparation.

Original_task_description: `Toewijzen` purchased quantity to underlying project/production demand
Rule: Purchasing allocation to underlying project or production demand.

Original_task_description: Determine whether proactive pre-PO price check is required
Short_label: Decide whether a price check is needed
Rule: Determine the need for a pre-order check.

Original_task_description: Search current supplier price and compare with stored Exact price
Rule: Applying existing supplier information; VW3 only if actual negotiation occurs.

Original_task_description: Update pre-PO price in Exact when outdated/deviating
Short_label: Update the pre-order price in Exact
Rule: Correct the record during order preparation.

Original_task_description: Prepare / complete supplier PO using the selected or already consolidated demand
Rule: Prepare the purchase order.

Original_task_description: Check whether order is within buyer authorization
Rule: Internal order authorization does not itself establish contract negotiation.

Original_task_description: If within authority, perform `Fiatteren` / `Verrichten`
Rule: Approve and release the order.

Original_task_description: If above authority, route order to higher-authority approver for `Fiatteren`
Short_label: Route the order to an approver
Rule: Internal order approval handoff.

Original_task_description: Continue Exact workflow after higher-authority `Fiatteren`
Rule: Stage is clear; the exact actor and action still need a case trace.

Original_task_description: After release, Exact generates the supplier-facing PO document and emails the buyer
Short_label: Generate the PO document and buyer email
Rule: System event only; count buyer time only for a separately observed action.

Original_task_description: Buyer forwards generated PO with standard supplier message
Short_label: Forward the PO to the supplier
Rule: Sending places the order with the supplier.

Original_task_description: A newly generated PO record appears as `Besteld` in Exact and becomes open PO work; this status is distinct from manual supplier forwarding
Rule: Status event is distinct from supplier forwarding; do not add automatic workload.

Original_task_description: Supplier sends order confirmation
Rule: Supplier action is not buyer time; classify actual receipt or reading separately.

Original_task_description: Compare supplier confirmation with PO / Exact
Rule: Check the supplier response against the order.

Original_task_description: Correct relevant confirmation deviations in Exact
Rule: Administration belonging to confirmation control.

Original_task_description: Attach/archive confirmation and set `Bevestigd`
Rule: Completes confirmation processing; it does not mean goods are received.

Original_task_description: Finance performs later control and determines whether an issue exists
Rule: Outside the buyer time profile; the transaction stage must be established.

Original_task_description: If Finance returns an issue, buyer investigates the returned case
Rule: EXC is excluded. Do not infer completed delivery from a Finance question alone.

Original_task_description: Handle a supplier-reported unavailable component: search for an alternative and remove the unavailable line if no alternative is found
Rule: May involve VW5 follow-up, VW1 substitution or VW4 amendment; VW2 only if supplier choice is evidenced. Apply EXC scope independently.
